title: Propulsion is having a moment
summary: The article highlights the growing importance of propulsion in the space industry, featuring an interview with Kevin Lausten, CEO of Morpheus Space, at the 2026 Small Satellite Conference.

title: Space Angel secures $1.75m WA Government backing to advance Western Australian spaceport plans
summary: Space Angel received a $1.75 million grant from the Western Australian Government to advance plans for a local spaceport. The funding was announced by Science and Innovation Minister Stephen Dawson.

title: Tendeg Launches NewTEN Steerable Compact Antenna at SmallSat
summary: Tendeg unveiled NewTEN, a two-axis steerable compact antenna designed to enhance communications performance and pointing access for small spacecraft. The product was introduced at the SmallSat event in Salt Lake City.

title: Robotics and the future of on-orbit labor
summary: SpaceNews interviews Icarus Robotics CEO Ethan Barajas at the 2026 Small Satellite Conference about the role of robotics in future on-orbit labor. The discussion highlights advancements in space robotics and their potential impact on satellite operations.

title: Spirit Electronics Adds Texas Instruments and Microchip Technology Space Grade Components to Online Store Ahead of SmallSat 2026
summary: Spirit Electronics expanded its online store to include space-grade components from Texas Instruments and Microchip Technology ahead of SmallSat 2026. This move supports high-reliability electronics for space applications.

title: The Fuel for the Next Generation of Cislunar Exploration? Technology and Talent.
summary: The article discusses the advancements in technology and talent that will drive future cislunar exploration, building on the legacy of the Apollo moon landings. It highlights the ongoing benefits of past achievements in science and national security.

title: Tory Bruno Named Honorary Chair Of World Space Week 2027
summary: Tory Bruno, President of National Security at Blue Origin, has been named Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2027. The World Space Week Association made the announcement highlighting his leadership in the space industry.

title: New Novaspace forecast: 6,500+ EO satellites to launch by 2035
summary: Novaspace predicts over 6,500 Earth observation satellites will launch by 2035, generating $155.9 billion in manufacturing revenue as governments increase sovereign intelligence and surveillance capabilities.

title: Elve qualifies millimeter-wave amplifiers for spaceflight
summary: Elve, a California startup, has qualified its 100-watt millimeter-wave Traveling Wave Tube Amplifier platform for spaceflight. The qualification was supported by U.S. Space Force Small Business Innovation Research funding.

title: What’s next for ISR in space
summary: A SpaceNews panel led by correspondent Debra Werner discusses the future of Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) in space. The discussion was recorded in May.

title: SpaceX's final Falcon 9 Starlink launch from Florida creates gorgeous 'jellyfish' over New York City (video)
summary: SpaceX's final Falcon 9 Starlink launch from Florida produced a visible 'jellyfish' effect in the sky over New York City. The launch created a stunning visual display hundreds of miles away.

title: SpaceX sends Starlink satellites to orbit on predawn launch from California
summary: SpaceX launched 27 Starlink broadband satellites into orbit from California's central coast in a predawn mission. This marks another deployment in the company's ongoing Starlink constellation expansion.

title: Inside the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, NASA's next great observatory
summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is set to launch on August 30, featuring major components designed for advanced astronomical observations. The observatory is positioned as the agency's next great space observatory.

title: Watch the partial lunar eclipse online Aug. 27-28 with these free livestreams
summary: A partial lunar eclipse will be livestreamed online on Aug. 27-28 starting at 9:23 p.m. EDT (0123 GMT). Several free livestreams will be available to watch the celestial event.

title: 'You just saved the video dish': Two astronauts complete spacewalk to replace ISS antenna
summary: Two astronauts, Anil Menon and Sophie Adenot, completed a 6.5-hour spacewalk to replace an antenna on the International Space Station. The installation of the new Space-to-Ground antenna ensures continued communication capabilities for the ISS.

title: Starbase Louisiana: SpaceX announces enormous $100 billion Starbase launch site
summary: SpaceX has announced plans to build a massive $100 billion Starbase launch site in Louisiana, featuring 10 launch pads and capable of supporting thousands of Starship launches annually.

title: The bubbling surface of doomed supergiant star Betelgeuse has been revealed like never before
summary: Astronomers have captured a new, detailed view of the bubbling surface of the supergiant star Betelgeuse, revealing unprecedented details of the doomed star. This breakthrough provides fresh insights into the behavior of this well-studied but enigmatic stellar object.

title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope will reveal the universe in a way the JWST and Hubble cannot
summary: NASA's Roman Space Telescope is expected to capture unprecedentedly large images of the universe, surpassing the capabilities of JWST and Hubble. The images will be so vast that no existing screen can display them in full.

title: NOAA issues geomagnetic storm watch as CMEs head toward Earth — northern lights possible Aug. 27-28
summary: NOAA has issued a geomagnetic storm watch as coronal mass ejections (CMEs) approach Earth, potentially causing northern lights displays on August 27-28. The event is driven by incoming CMEs and a fast solar wind stream.

title: Starbase, Louisiana: The Largest Private Spaceport in the World
summary: SpaceX has announced plans to build 'Starbase, Louisiana,' which will be the largest private spaceport in the world. The facility is intended to support SpaceX's growing space operations.

title: Starbase’s future production capacity ramping up
summary: Starbase's production site is experiencing increased activity to boost future production capacity. The developments are aimed at scaling up operations at the facility.

title: Launch Preview: Falcon Heavy to launch Roman telescope, Falcon 9 to launch Starlink satellites
summary: Falcon Heavy is set to launch NASA's Roman Space Telescope, while Falcon 9 will deploy Starlink satellites. Five orbital launches are scheduled from China, the U.S., and French Guiana this week.

title: NASA’s Roman telescope nears launch, reaches final integration and rehearsal milestones
summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is nearing its scheduled launch date of August 30 after reaching final integration and rehearsal milestones.

title: LandSpace’s Zhuque-3 topples following milestone landing
summary: LandSpace's Zhuque-3 rocket toppled after achieving a significant milestone with a successful landing. This marks a major advancement for China's commercial space industry.

title: Ship 41 Completes Engine Testing Ahead of Flight 14
summary: Ship 41 has completed engine testing in preparation for Flight 14. Meanwhile, Ship 40 is being transported back to Starbase from Christmas Island.

title: Stoke Space conducts second stage fit checks, completes first stage engines ahead of Nova debut
summary: Stoke Space has completed fit checks for the second stage and finished building the first stage engines of its Nova rocket, marking progress toward a potential debut in 2026. This development highlights Stoke Space's push to join the reusable launch vehicle market alongside competitors like SpaceX.

title: Zhuque-3 Completes Second Flight with Successful First-Stage Landing
summary: Zhuque-3, a methalox rocket developed by LandSpace, successfully completed its second flight and achieved a first-stage landing. This milestone marks a significant advancement for the company in reusable rocket technology.

title: Ship 40 arrives at Christmas Island, Plans Return to Starbase
summary: SpaceX has successfully guided Starship Ship 40 to a location off the coast of Christmas Island. The company plans to return the ship to its Starbase facility.

title: Launch Preview: Chang’e 7 headlines week of Chinese and Starlink launches
summary: China is preparing for the Chang'e 7 mission following a recent launch failure, while SpaceX's Starlink launches also feature prominently in the upcoming week's space activities.

title: TEC Business to Business website
summary: TEC Business to Business website is mentioned, but no specific details about the space industry news are provided.

title: ESA Delivers: 50 years booklet
summary: ESA celebrates its 50th anniversary by releasing a booklet highlighting 50 major achievements over the past five decades. The publication underscores the agency's contributions to space exploration and technology.

title: Phoenix 3: concept study for a reusable European spacecraft
summary: Engineers from ESA and industry partners completed a concept study for Phoenix 3, a reusable spacecraft for microgravity experiments and Earth return.

title: Proba-3’s eclipse hours before totality in Europe
summary: Proba-3, a European Space Agency mission, will create an artificial solar eclipse to study the Sun's corona just hours before the total solar eclipse in Europe. The mission aims to provide unprecedented observations of the Sun's outer atmosphere.

title: A double eclipse for Proba-3
summary: Proba-3 will experience a double eclipse as the Moon crosses its field of view. This event highlights the satellite's precise orbital maneuvers.

title: How ESA mimics and models the 2026 total solar eclipse
summary: ESA is preparing to study the 2026 total solar eclipse by using artificial eclipse missions and computer simulations to observe the Sun's corona, which is otherwise difficult to study due to the rarity and brevity of natural eclipses.

title: Your chance to run software in deep space on ESA's asteroid mission
summary: The European Space Agency is inviting European researchers and companies to run their software aboard the Hera mission, a deep space asteroid mission. This offers a unique opportunity to test software millions of kilometers from Earth.

title: From drone flight to sounding rocket
summary: A student-developed radar retroreflector technology was tested for the first time using a drone at ESTEC, the European Space Agency’s technical centre in the Netherlands. This marks a transition from drone flight to sounding rocket applications.

title: Earth and Proba-3’s Coronagraph play hide and seek
summary: ESA's Proba-3 mission will demonstrate formation flying by using a coronagraph to block the Sun's light, allowing it to observe the solar corona while Earth hides the Sun. This technology aims to improve solar observation capabilities.

title: Meet space startups at ESA’s Industry Space Days
summary: ESA's Industry Space Days event on 16–17 September at ESA-ESTEC in the Netherlands will bring together startup companies and Europe's space industry to exchange ideas, showcase capabilities, and explore collaboration opportunities.

title: Exclusive: City Labs Plans Second Nuclear Demo
summary: City Labs is planning a second nuclear demo following the success of its first nuclear-powered betavoltaic demo. The upcoming demo will feature a radioisotope heating unit.

title: White House Wants 1,000 Annual Launches and Reentries by 2030
summary: The White House has introduced a new National Space Transportation Policy aiming for 1,000 annual launches and reentries by 2030, replacing the 2013 policy. This initiative seeks to significantly boost space transportation capabilities.

title: The Aerospace Corp’s Disksat Gains Commercial Traction
summary: The Aerospace Corporation's DiskSat, a novel box-less satellite design, is gaining commercial interest. This innovative configuration is proving to be a successful departure from traditional satellite designs.

title: Exclusive: OrbitAID to Launch RPO Demo in 2027
summary: OrbitAID plans to launch a rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) demonstration in 2027 to test the entire satellite life extension process in a single mission. This will be the first demonstration to qualify the full sequence, unlike previous isolated tests.

title: Beyond Reach Labs Unveils Flarewing Deployable Solar Arrays
summary: Beyond Reach Labs has unveiled its Flarewing deployable solar arrays, a patent-pending system designed to fold flat during launch. This technology aims to optimize solar power generation for spacecraft.

title: Starcloud Announces $250M Series A Extension
summary: Starcloud has secured a $250 million extension to its Series A funding round, bringing the total to $420 million and valuing the company at $2.3 billion.

title: Letara Raises ¥2.6B to Build its Hybrid Rocket Engine Tech
summary: Japanese propulsion startup Letara raised ¥2.6 billion ($16 million) in a pre-Series A funding round to develop its low-cost hybrid rocket engine technology.

title: SpaceWERX Announces 2026 STRATFI Awardees
summary: SpaceWERX announced the newest awardees of the 2026 STRATFI program during the Fed Supernova conference. The Space Force revealed these recipients as part of its Strategic Funding Increase initiative.

title: Op-ed: The Technologies That Could Define the Future of Space
summary: Daniel Biedermann, a partner at NewSpace Capital, discusses the key technologies shaping the future of space. The op-ed highlights emerging trends in the space industry.

title: Muon Space Raises $250M Series C
summary: Muon Space secured $250 million in a Series C funding round to expand its satellite production capacity and diversify its mission capabilities.

title: Lyntris Targets Faster Delivery Timelines in Smallsat Interview With Madison Dye
summary: Lyntris, a new defense tech company formed by the merger of Vitesse Systems and Accelint, aims to improve delivery timelines for small satellites. The company focuses on supporting defense and national security missions in space.

title: Impulse Space Scales Rideshare Program to GEO With Increased Demand
summary: Impulse Space has fully booked three rideshare missions to Geostationary Orbit (GEO) through 2028 due to increased demand. The company is now considering doubling its rideshare missions to meet this growing interest.

title: Redwire to Manufacture Edge Aerospace Data Processing Units in US
summary: Edge Aerospace has partnered with Redwire to manufacture its data processing units (DPUs) in the U.S. under a licensing agreement. This collaboration aims to scale Edge Aerospace's production capabilities within the country.

title: CesiumAstro Acquires 1Aardvark, Its 3rd Defense Systems Acquisition This Year
summary: CesiumAstro acquired 1Aardvark, a Virginia-based mission software and defense systems engineering company, marking its third defense systems acquisition this year. The deal expands CesiumAstro's capabilities in space-based communications and intelligence.

title: TrustPoint Aces C-band GNSS Interference Demo for U.S. Naval Air Systems Command
summary: TrustPoint successfully demonstrated its C-band GNSS interference mitigation capabilities under a contract with the U.S. Naval Air Systems Command. This marks a significant milestone for the company's space-based positioning and navigation solutions.

title: SSC Space Execs Talk Ground Service and Lunar Mission Growth at Smallsat
summary: SSC Space executives discussed ground services and lunar mission growth at the Small Satellite Conference. The interviews highlighted the company's offerings and future plans.

title: NanoAvionics Upgrades its Flagship MP42 Bus Line, Adding a 500kg Platform
summary: NanoAvionics has upgraded its MP42 satellite bus line with a new 500 kg platform, marking its largest offering to date. The company, based in Kongsberg, announced the enhancement aimed at expanding its payload capacity for customers.

title: Kepler Launches Service on its New Optical Data Relay Constellation
summary: Kepler Communications has launched service on its new optical data relay constellation for global commercial and government customers. The service became active following a SpaceX launch.

title: KSAT Rolls Out Demonstration Campaign for Hyper Hybrid RF/Optional Network
summary: KSAT has launched a demonstration campaign for its next-generation hybrid RF/optical relay network called Hyper. The campaign aims to showcase the capabilities of the Hyperion system.

title: SDA Director Says Constellation’s Tranche 1 Checkouts Progressing Faster After a Slow Start
summary: The Space Development Agency's Tranche 1 satellite constellation is experiencing faster-than-expected on-orbit checkouts after a slow initial start. SDA Director Dr. Gurpartap emphasized the improved progress during an update.
